target.name: ByteCodeInterpreter collection reader (sub_08011C70)
target.role: search the collection by virtual dispatch over its elements
target.notes: sub_08011C70, 88 bytes and 44 instructions, one terminator at 0x08011CC8. It is called WITH the collection object in r0, and apart from the virtual call it makes it is a leaf. THE CONCRETE EFFECT: a SEARCH performed by VIRTUAL DISPATCH. For each element from the TOP of the collection DOWNWARD it dereferences the element, takes the method at offset +0x24 of the table the element's first word points at, calls it with the two incoming arguments unchanged, and RETURNS THE FIRST NON-ZERO RESULT IMMEDIATELY. If nothing matches it returns 0. THE COLLECTION LAYOUT, PROVEN A THIRD TIME AND NOW FROM DIFFERENT INSTRUCTIONS: count at collection + 0x04, elements from collection + 0x08, each element a 32-BIT POINTER to a virtual object whose FIRST WORD is a table pointer. TRAVERSAL: BACKWARD, from count-1 down to 0, so the MOST RECENTLY APPENDED element is tested FIRST; the index is decremented before the loop and the loop continues on `bpl`. COUNT 0: the index goes to -1 and the `bmi` skips the loop entirely, so an empty collection causes NO call at all. THE COUNT IS READ ONLY; there is no store to +0x04 anywhere. CAPACITY EVIDENCE, FOUND HERE AND NOT INFERRED: the routine searches a SECOND collection of the SAME SHAPE at object + 0x408, whose count is at object + 0x40C and whose elements begin at object + 0x410, because it adds 0x40C to the object base and then reads the count from that address. The object therefore carries TWO collections 0x408 bytes apart. +0x00 IS NOT TOUCHED by this reader. THE VIRTUAL CALL: the original reaches the method through the `bx r3` thunk at 0x08046AA6, a trampoline the original toolchain emitted for an indirect call; the reconstruction expresses the same operation as a plain call through a function pointer, which is what the trampoline achieves, so no external symbol is introduced. NO BOUNDS CHECK on the count and no null check on an element, and none was added. UNKNOWN: what the collection holds, what the element type or the method is, how large either collection may grow, and what +0x00 is. No semantic name is assigned and nothing is imported from another title.
